title: Documentation Site Harvester
subtitle: Crawls a documentation website inside set domain and path boundaries, cleans each page into readable text, splits it into sections, writes a summary, keywords and a quality score for each section, and makes the whole site searchable.
lede: Crawls a documentation website inside set domain and path boundaries, cleans each page into readable text, splits it into sections, writes a summary, keywords and a quality score for each section, and makes the whole site searchable. Later passes re-crawl only what is new or changed.
who: A platform team or developer relations lead who wants a vendor's or partner's documentation searchable next to the team's own work
author: Corey James
